fact: The Auditor-General reported to the Portfolio Committee, on the 2024/25 audit outcomes, that the SA-SAMS modernisation project was delayed by a year due to reliance on donor funding, and recommended that the Council of Education Ministers and HEDCOM prioritise accelerating it.
title: Basic Education Portfolio Audit Outcomes; DBE 2024/25 Annual Report; Readiness for 2025 NSC Exams; with the Minister and Deputy Minister
